findings.title: CI lint gate (ruff, whole-tree) fails on unused imports in Phase-101 sanitization test files
findings.problem: `ruff check src/python/` — the exact whole-tree command CI runs as a gate separate from pytest — currently reports 3 F401 errors, all in test modules added by this same CWE-117 sanitization phase: `unittest.mock.call` unused at test_controller/test_controller.py:4:38, `logging` unused at test_lftp/test_lftp_log_sanitization.py:11:8, and `unittest.mock.PropertyMock` unused at test_lftp/test_lftp_log_sanitization.py:13:45. The changed file itself is clean, so this diff does not introduce the errors, but it lands into a tree whose lint gate is already red. All three are auto-fixable (`ruff check --fix`).
findings.fix_hint: Run `ruff check --fix src/python/` to drop the 3 unused test imports before pushing this phase.
findings.why_it_matters: CI runs ruff whole-tree as its own gate; a red lint stage blocks the merge of an otherwise-correct security fix, and the failure is unrelated to the change under review so it reads as noise and invites the gate being waved through.
source_window: This is a focused test module that avoids the full pexpect-heavy Lftp integration suite.
